name: observability-instrumentation
description: Instrument code with structured logging, RED metrics, and OpenTelemetry tracing. Configure symptom-based alerting with runbooks. Inspired by agent-skills.

inputs.name: instrumentationLevel
inputs.description: Level: 'logs' (structured logging only), 'metrics' (logs + RED metrics), 'full' (logs + metrics + tracing). Default: 'metrics'.

outputs.name: instrumentationReport
outputs.description: Report: filesInstrumented, logStatementsAdded, metricsAdded, tracesAdded, runbookPath.

failureConditions.description: console.log used instead of structured logging

failureConditions.signal: diff contains password, token, or PII in log statements
